theme: Skia m151 with a performance sweep
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 moves the engine to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed code.
highlights_body: This release adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, and optimizes color conversion, HarfBuzz buffer encoding, and span-based glyph reading.

bullets.detail: Updates Skia to milestone m151 and merges several rounds of upstream m151 bug fixes.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing gains Span overloads
bullets.detail: Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor hex parsing and optimizes the parsing path.
Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI).
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression introduced upstream.

bullets.lead: Hot paths ported to managed C# and made allocation-free
bullets.detail: SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse avoid per-call allocations, SKFourByteTag.Parse drops a per-call char[4] allocation, and SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans.
Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception handling for .NET 11 WASM, plus a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11 and bumped the Skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line, bumping Skia to milestone m151 and beginning the managed performance sweep.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11 and continued porting hot paths to allocation-free managed code.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak and the CPU raster regression ahead of shipping.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, alongside the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM library update.
